text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Mommy, dinner's super fancy today. Is 
something special going on?

text_block_list.name: Loves's Mother
text_block_list.text:
What are you saying?! You're right here, 
you've come home. What other reason could 
there be?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Big Sis said she's eating dinner at home 
today too.

text_block_list.name: Loves's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I've heard—ah. Looks like Dad just 
landed at the airport too! It feels like 
all four of us will finally get to share a 
meal at the table again after so long♪

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Huh, Papa is coming home too!? Even though 
he's so busy... Hehe♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seemed Loves Only You had a meaningful 
day off!
